location: Nauvis - New Dawn - Ash Processing Sector
summary: Today was focused on finally wrapping up a number of long-standing infrastructure tasks that have been piling up.
I started by adjusting the power grid layout slightly to free up space, which allowed me to fully set up crystal mining across the entire quartz patch.
I also relocated the glassworks and expanded its capacity. While glass itself is not currently in high demand, the increased production allows me to burn through excess gasoline more efficiently.
For now, most of the glass is simply being stored for future use.
Another major milestone was completing flooring across the entire base using stone and concrete.
With the ground fully prepared, I can now build anywhere within the base without restriction, and movement speed across the factory has noticeably improved.
I also began construction of the long-awaited new ash processing sector.
The initial setup includes 12 solid separators dedicated to ash processing and 2 additional separators handling soot.
I managed to reroute part of the ash logistics into the new facility, but ran out of time before completing the full transition.
The remaining connections should be finished tomorrow, at which point ash processing should be significantly more stable and scalable.
On the research front, I completed Acetylene processing.
This technology has been recommended by multiple engineers over telecommunications, suggesting it may play an important role in advancing the base further.
I will begin looking into setting up acetylene production next.

status.power: Power grid adjusted and stable; additional space created for expansion.
status.resource: Quartz fully utilized; excess gasoline effectively consumed via expanded glass production.
status.production: New ash processing sector partially online; full integration still in progress.
status.science: Acetylene research completed; next step is implementation.
status.defense: Perimeter defenses remain stable with no major incidents reported.
